title: SDLC Evidence Tier v1
description: The shared evidence-tier vocabulary used by task evidence, validation, implementation verification, test strategies, and review inputs.
$comment: These values classify the strongest evidence actually established by a source. A host may define ordering and policy-specific mappings, but a review or task result must not claim a tier higher than its underlying evidence. The repository filename is the resolver target; the public vocabulary is versioned by this stable schema identity.
